title: Fix pylint CI action exiting with code 28 despite score meeting threshold
body:
Pylint exits non-zero (code 28 = W|R|C message category bits) whenever warning/refactor/convention messages are found, regardless of `--fail-under`. The threshold flag only adds failure bits when the score drops *below* the threshold — it cannot suppress message-category exit codes. Since the codebase has W/R/C messages, pylint exited 28 even with a score of 8.50/10 (at the 8.5 threshold), causing the action to fail.

## Changes

- **`.github/workflows/pylint.yml`**: Replace `--fail-under=8.5` with `--exit-zero` + score-parsing step
  - `--exit-zero` prevents pylint from failing on message-category exit codes
  - A Python one-liner parses the score from pylint's output and fails the step only if it drops below 8.5

```yaml
- name: Analysing the code with pylint
  run: |
    pylint $(git ls-files '*.py') --exit-zero | tee /tmp/pylint_output.txt
    python3 -c "
    import re, sys
    with open('/tmp/pylint_output.txt') as f:
        content = f.read()
    match = re.search(r'rated at (\d+\.\d+)', content)
    if not match:
        print('Could not parse pylint score')
        sys.exit(1)
    score = float(match.group(1))
    threshold = 8.5
    print(f'Pylint score: {score}/10 (threshold: {threshold})')
    sys.exit(0 if score >= threshold else 1)
    "
```
